transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you in today?
Well… I guess I’m here because I’ve been avoiding things. My workshop, mostly. And some family gatherings if I think my brother-in-law might be there. It’s gotten old, having to plan around all that.
Can you tell me more about why you avoid your workshop and those family gatherings?

It’s… mostly that those places bring things back up. The workshop used to be my own space, but now I just find reasons not to go in there. And if there’s a family thing where my brother-in-law might show up, I usually skip it. I’m just tired of arranging everything around avoiding those reminders.
Have you been having intrusive or distressing memories about something that happened in the workshop or during a family gathering?

Yeah… sometimes. It’ll just pop in my head out of nowhere — his hand holding that heavy tool. Like a picture, real quick. I can be shaving or trying to paint, and then it’s there, and my chest gets tight.
Can you tell me more about what happened in the workshop or during a family gathering that’s been coming back to you?

I don’t really like going into the whole thing. It’s more what comes back… just out of nowhere I’ll see his hand with that heavy tool again. Like a picture in my head. It can happen when I’m shaving, or working on a painting, and my chest tightens up.
